notes: Same 8-unit townhouse building as elec-tx-taylor-northbb-54-61, scored for the structural disciplines. Footprint 139'-8" x 55' (slab ≈7,700 SF gross). The CAD text layer INTERLEAVES note columns word-by-word (it is unreadable as prose), which is why building_plan prefers vision. The set carries REAL internal conflicts (4000 vs 3000 psi slab, 10 vs 6 mil poly, PT slab on A13 vs conventional on A4/A12): a faithful extraction keeps ONE line and records the conflict in `assumptions` rather than emitting both — a second slab line is over-extraction, not recall. Anchors from the 2026-07-22 vision ground-truth session; sizes are exact, quantities are ±.
